entities.summary: Francesca Balzani is an Italian politician and lawyer. She served as a City Councilor for the Budget of the Municipality of Genoa from 2007 to 2009 and was a Member of the European Parliament for the Democratic Party during the 7th legislature. From 2015 to 2016, she held the office of Deputy Mayor of Milan.
